name: boot
side-0-setup
js: (async () => { await window.__swerve.setup({ name: 'side', kind: 'side', X: -2047, Z: -2307, lead: 42 }); window.__swerve.log('setup'); })()

name: side-1-approach
js: (async () => { const S = window.__swerve; await S.until((c) => c.pAhead < 24 || c.dodge, 600); S.log('approach'); })()

name: side-2-out
js: (async () => { const S = window.__swerve; await S.until((c) => (c.dodge && Math.abs(c.dl) > 1.1) || c.pAhead < 2, 1500); S.log('out'); })()

name: side-3-alongside
js: (async () => { const S = window.__swerve; await S.until((c) => c.pAhead < 0.3, 900); S.log('alongside'); })()

name: side-4-past
js: (async () => { const S = window.__swerve; await S.until((c) => c.pAhead < -10 || (!c.dodge && Math.abs(c.dl) < 0.3 && c.pAhead < -4), 900); S.log('past'); })()

name: king-0-setup
js: (async () => { await window.__swerve.setup({ name: 'king', kind: 'king', X: -1000, Z: -350, lead: 40, curb: true }); window.__swerve.log('setup'); })()

name: king-1-approach
js: (async () => { const S = window.__swerve; await S.until((c) => c.pAhead < 24 || c.dodge, 600); S.log('approach'); })()

name: cross-0-setup
js: (async () => { await window.__swerve.setup({ name: 'cross', kind: 'side', X: -2047, Z: -2307, lead: 30, speed: 11, skip: 1, walk: { offset: 5, input: 0.45 } }); window.__swerve.log('setup'); })()

name: cross-1-react
js: (async () => { const S = window.__swerve; await S.until((c) => c.panicUntil > 0, 150); S.log('react'); })()

name: cross-2-swerve
js: (async () => { const S = window.__swerve; await S.until((c) => Math.abs(c.dl) > 1 || c.speed < 0.2 || c.pAhead < -3, 90); S.log('swerve'); })()

name: cross-3-after
js: (async () => { const S = window.__swerve; await S.until((c) => c.pAhead < -6 || c.speed < 0.2, 200); S.log('after'); window.__CITY_APP.controllerManager.setGamepadInput('forward', 0); })()

js: (async () => { await window.__swerve.setup({ name: 'kingcross', kind: 'king', X: -1000, Z: -350, lead: 30, speed: 11, curb: true, skip: 1, walk: { offset: 3.6, input: 0.45 } }); window.__swerve.log('setup'); })()
